info.title: Plunk API
info.description: Open-source email platform API for transactional emails, campaigns, and marketing automation

ApiKeyAuth.description:
API Key authentication. The project is automatically derived from the key.

**`/v1/track` requires a public key (`pk_*`)** — it is the one endpoint intended for client-side use, and a secret key is rejected there with `401`.

**Every other endpoint requires a secret key (`sk_*`)** and rejects public keys with `401`.

So the two key types are not interchangeable in either direction: pick the key that matches the endpoint you are calling.

from.description: Sender address. Must belong to a verified domain.

type.description: Content type of the campaign email. Not to be confused with `audienceType`.

scheduledFor.description: When the campaign is scheduled to send. Null for immediate or unsent campaigns.

type.description: `DYNAMIC` segments are evaluated from `condition`. `STATIC` segments hold a manually managed member list.

condition.description: Filter condition for `DYNAMIC` segments. Null for `STATIC` segments.

trackMembership.description: When true, contacts entering or leaving the segment emit `segment.<slug>.entry` / `segment.<slug>.exit` events.

memberCount.description: Cached member count, refreshed by a background job rather than computed per request.

field.description: Contact field to test. Custom fields are addressed via the `data.` prefix (e.g. `data.plan`); standard fields are `email`, `subscribed`, `createdAt`. Event operators take an event name instead.

value.description: Comparison value. Omitted for `exists` / `notExists` / `triggered` / `notTriggered`. For time-window operators this is the number of `unit`s.

filters.description: Filters within a group are combined with AND.

conditions.description: Optional nested condition, allowing arbitrarily deep AND/OR trees.

FilterCondition.description: A boolean tree over contact filters. `logic` combines the `groups`; the filters inside each group are always ANDed together.

LegacyError.description: Flat error shape returned by the hand-validated create/update endpoints (`POST /contacts`, `POST /templates`, `POST /segments`) for missing required fields. Unlike the rest of the API these return `400` with a bare `error` string rather than the standard envelope. Errors raised deeper in those same endpoints (404, 409, domain verification) still use the standard `Error` envelope.

field.description: Dot-path of the offending field, e.g. `attachments.0.filename`.

received.description: The value that was received, when available.

requestId.description: Correlation ID for this request. Include it when contacting support.

errors.description: Field-level detail, present on validation failures.

Limit.name: limit
Limit.description: Maximum items per page. Values above 100 are clamped to 100.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Pagination cursor. Pass the `cursor` returned by the previous page.

SortDirection.name: dir
SortDirection.description: Sort direction. Unrecognised values fall back to the default.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Optional key that guarantees this request runs at most once. If the key was already used by your project, the request is refused with `409` instead of being performed a second time. Keys are scoped to your project, expire after 24 hours (configurable when self-hosting), and must be 1-255 printable ASCII characters.

ValidationError.description: Request body failed schema validation. `error.errors` lists the offending fields.

error.suggestion: Please check the API documentation for the correct request format.

error.message: Invalid secret API key. This endpoint requires a secret key (sk_*), not a public key.

UnverifiedDomain.description: The sender domain is not registered to this project, or has not completed DNS verification. Add and verify the domain in your project settings first.

error.message: Domain "example.com" is not verified. Please complete the DNS verification process in your domain settings.

NotFound.description: The requested resource does not exist in this project.

IdempotencyConflict.description: Idempotency-Key already used. The request was refused, not performed.

error.suggestion: This Idempotency-Key was already used, so the request was refused rather than performed twice. Generate a new key for a genuinely new request.

post.description:
Send a transactional email via the public API. Automatically creates or updates the recipient contact.

**Required content:** either a `template` ID, **or** both `subject` and `body`. Template fields can be overridden by explicit request fields.

**Sender:** `from` is required unless using a template that already has a `from` configured. The sender's domain must be verified.

**Multiple recipients:** when `to` is an array, each recipient is processed sequentially with its own contact upsert and rendered email — there is no batch-send semantics. Sending is always immediate; for scheduled sends, use a Campaign.

**Attachments:** up to 10 attachments per email and 10 MB total by default. The total message size cannot exceed 40 MB.

to.description: Recipient email(s). Can be a string, an object with {name, email}, or an array of either.

subject.description: Email subject. Required if no `template` is provided. Cannot contain newline characters.

body.description: Email body (HTML). Required if no `template` is provided.

template.description: Template ID to use for this email. When provided, uses the template's subject, body, from, and reply-to settings. You can override these by explicitly providing subject, body, from, or reply fields in the request. Template variables are populated from the data field.

from.description: Sender email address (requires verified domain). Required unless using a template that has a 'from' address configured. Can be a string (e.g., 'hello@example.com') or an object with {name, email} (e.g., {name: 'My App', email: 'hello@example.com'}).

name.description: **Deprecated.** Sender display name. Prefer `from: { name, email }`. Used only as a fallback when `from` is a string and no name is set there.

subscribed.description: Subscription state to apply to the recipient. For **new** contacts, defaults to `false` on `/v1/send`. For **existing** contacts, omitting this preserves their current state — pass `true` or `false` to explicitly change it. A change emits `contact.subscribed` or `contact.unsubscribed`.

data.description:
Variables for template rendering and contact data updates. Each value can be:
- A primitive (string, number, boolean) — saved on the contact and available as a template variable.
- `null` — deletes the field from the contact.
- An empty string — skipped (does not overwrite existing data).
- An object `{ value, persistent: false }` — used for this send only, not stored on the contact (good for one-shot password reset codes, magic links).

Reserved keys (`id`, `plunk_id`, `plunk_email`, `email`, `unsubscribeUrl`, `subscribeUrl`, `manageUrl`) are silently filtered out.

headers.description: Custom email headers. Header names cannot contain `\r\n`. Header values are limited to 998 characters and cannot contain `\r\n` (header injection is rejected).

attachments.description: Email attachments. Default cap: 10 attachments and 10 MB total. The full message size cannot exceed 40 MB.

filename.description: Attachment filename. Cannot contain newline or quote characters.

contentId.description: Content-ID for inline images. Required when `disposition` is `inline`. Reference the image in the email body via ``.

disposition.description: Use `inline` together with `contentId` to embed images in the body. Use `attachment` (the default) for downloadable files.

value.subject: Password Reset Request
value.body:
Reset Your Password

Click the link to reset: {{resetLink}}

withNames.summary: Email with recipient and sender names

withTemplate.description: Send email using a template. Provide the template ID and any data for template variables. The template's subject, body, from address, and reply-to will be used automatically.

withTemplateOverride.description: You can override template values by providing subject, body, from, or reply fields. This example overrides the template's subject line.

email.description: Plunk email record ID. Use this to correlate webhook events (which include this ID as 'emailId' in the event data) with your send requests.

400.description: Malformed JSON body, or an invalid `Idempotency-Key` header.

403.description: The project is disabled and cannot send.

404.description: The `template` ID does not exist in this project.

post.description:
Track an event for a contact. Automatically creates or upserts the contact, then records the event. Tracked events can be used as workflow triggers, segment filters, and audience filters.

**Reserved event names** (rejected with `VALIDATION_ERROR` and code `reserved_event`): anything matching `email.*`, `contact.subscribed`, `contact.unsubscribed`, `segment.<slug>.entry`, `segment.<slug>.exit`. These are emitted by Plunk itself.

**Idempotency**: re-tracking the same event creates a new event record. Send an `Idempotency-Key` header to have a repeated request refused with `409` instead.

email.description: Contact email. The contact is auto-created if it doesn't exist.

event.description: Event name. Cannot match the reserved patterns above.

subscribed.description: Subscription state to apply to the contact. **New** contacts default to subscribed (`true`). **Existing** contacts keep their current state unless you pass an explicit value here. Pass `false` to track an event without resubscribing an unsubscribed contact.

preserveExistingSubscription.description: When `true`, applies `subscribed` only if this request creates the contact. Existing contacts keep their stored subscription state, including when another request wins a concurrent first-contact race. Use with `subscribed: false` for one-call double opt-in.

data.description: Contact data and one-off event variables. Persistent values (primitives, plain objects) are saved on the contact and become available as template variables. Pass `{ value, persistent: false }` for one-shot variables that should not be stored on the contact (e.g. order IDs, transaction details). `null` deletes a field. Empty strings are ignored. Reserved keys are filtered out — see the contacts concept page.

post.description: Verify an email address for validity, check if it's from a disposable domain or personal email provider, verify MX records, and detect potential typos with suggestions.

valid.description: Whether the email appears to be valid overall

isDisposable.description: Whether the email is from a disposable/temporary email domain

isAlias.description: Whether the email is from a forwarding/alias service

isTypo.description: Whether a potential typo was detected in the email address

isPlusAddressed.description: Whether the email uses plus addressing (contains a + in the local part)

isPersonalEmail.description: Whether the email is from a personal/free email provider (Gmail, Hotmail, Yahoo, etc.)

domainExists.description: Whether the domain exists in DNS (has NS records)

hasWebsite.description: Whether the domain has a website (has DNS A or AAAA records) - informational only

hasMxRecords.description: Whether the domain has MX records configured for email delivery

suggestedEmail.description: Suggested correction if a typo was detected (optional)

reasons.description: Array of human-readable reasons describing the verification results

reasons: Possible typo detected, did you mean gmail.com?
Domain does not exist (no nameservers found)

get.description: Get a paginated list of contacts with cursor-based pagination.

parameters.name: subscribed
parameters.description: Filter by subscription state. Omit to return both subscribed and unsubscribed contacts.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Column to sort by. Unrecognised values fall back to `createdAt`.

cursor.description: Cursor for the next page. Pass this back as the `cursor` query parameter to fetch the next page.

total.description: Total count. Only populated on the first page (when no `cursor` is supplied); subsequent pages return `0` to avoid the recount cost.

post.description: Create a new contact or update existing (upsert by email)

get.description: Get a single contact by ID

patch.description: Update an existing contact's email, subscription state, or `data` fields.

email.description: Change the contact's email address. Returns 409 if another contact in the project already uses this email.

subscribed.description: Update subscription state. Flipping this fires `contact.subscribed` or `contact.unsubscribed`.

data.description: Patch contact data. `null` deletes a key, empty strings are ignored, primitives are stored. Reserved keys are silently filtered out.

409.description: An existing contact already uses the email you're trying to set.

get.description:
Get a paginated list of email templates.

This endpoint uses **offset pagination** (`page` / `pageSize`), not the cursor pagination used by `GET /contacts`.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive match on name, description, or subject.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Column to sort by. Unrecognised values fall back to `createdAt`.

total.description: Total templates matching the filters, across all pages.

post.description:
Create a new email template.

`from` is required and its domain must already be verified for this project, otherwise the request is rejected.

description.description: Optional internal note. Not sent to recipients.

body.description: HTML body. Use `{{variable}}` placeholders to interpolate contact data at send time.

from.description: Sender address. Must belong to a domain verified for this project.

get.description:
Get a paginated list of email campaigns.

This endpoint uses **offset pagination** (`page` / `pageSize`), not the cursor pagination used by `GET /contacts`.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by campaign status. An unrecognised value returns `400`.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive match on name, subject, or sender address.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Column to sort by. Unrecognised values fall back to `createdAt`.

total.description: Total campaigns matching the filters, across all pages.

post.description:
Create a new email campaign. Campaigns are created as `DRAFT`; use `POST /campaigns/{id}/send` to send or schedule one.

The sender domain must already be verified for this project.

**Audience:** `audienceType` decides which companion field is required — `SEGMENT` requires `segmentId`, `FILTERED` requires `audienceCondition`, and `ALL` requires neither.

from.description: Sender email address (must be from verified domain)

type.description: Content type of the campaign email. Defaults to `MARKETING`.

audienceCondition.description: Audience filter tree. Required when `audienceType` is `FILTERED`. Same structure as a segment's `condition`.

value.name: Premium announcement
value.subject: A new perk for premium users

filtered.description: Premium users who signed up in the last 30 days.

400.description: `segmentId` missing for a `SEGMENT` campaign, or `audienceCondition` missing for a `FILTERED` campaign.

post.description: Send a campaign immediately or schedule it for future delivery.

scheduledFor.description: Timestamp for when to send the campaign. Omit or set to null for immediate send. Any value `new Date()` can parse is accepted; an unparseable one returns `400`.

message.description: Human-readable confirmation, e.g. `Campaign is being sent`.

400.description: Unparseable `scheduledFor`, or the campaign is not in a sendable state.

422.description: The campaign `id` in the path is not a valid UUID.

get.description: Get all audience segments for the project, newest first. This endpoint is not paginated — it returns a bare array of every segment.

post.description:
Create a new audience segment.

**`DYNAMIC` segments** (the default) are defined by a `condition` — a boolean tree that is re-evaluated against your contacts, so membership changes on its own as contact data changes. `condition` is required for these.

**`STATIC` segments** hold a manually managed member list; `condition` is ignored. Add members with `POST /segments/{id}/members`.

condition.description: Required for `DYNAMIC` segments; ignored for `STATIC` ones.

trackMembership.description: Emit `segment.<slug>.entry` / `segment.<slug>.exit` events as contacts join and leave. These can be used as workflow triggers.

orLogic.description: Filters inside a group are ANDed; `logic` combines the groups. This matches premium users OR anyone who signed up in the last 7 days.

eventBased.description: Contacts who triggered `purchase` in the last 30 days.

400.description: `name` is missing, or `condition` is missing on a `DYNAMIC` segment.

example.error: Condition is required and must be an object for DYNAMIC segments
